hooks.name: Linear Issue Reminder on Commit
hooks.description: Remind agent to include Linear issue reference in commit messages (IDE only, skipped on spot)

action.command: bash -c '[ "$KIRO_SPOT" = "1" ] && exit 0; read -t 1 INPUT 2>/dev/null; CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git\s+commit"; then echo "LINEAR COMMIT CHECK: Ensure commit message or branch references a Linear issue (CORE-XXX)."; fi; exit 0'
